verdict.rationale: Jina Reader is a stateless URL-to-markdown and search API, and the evidence shows no saved automations, version history, review workflow, or rollback. Per-request headers and presets (e.g. x-preset) are request options, not versioned automations, so they earn no credit. A scraping or extraction service could plausibly offer saved, versioned jobs, so the axis applies; with no evidence of it, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
